helpers:
Public Log As String
Public N As Long
Public Armed As Boolean
Public Calls As Long
Function Tick(ByVal value As Double) As Double
Application.Volatile True
Calls = Calls + 1
Tick = value * 2
End Function
book_handler:
Private Sub Workbook_SheetCalculate(ByVal Sh As Object)
If Armed Then Log = Log & "b(" & CStr(Range("B1").Value2) & ");"
End Sub

probes.name: manual_app_ordinary_edit
probes.sheet_handler:
Private Sub Worksheet_Calculate()
If Not Armed Then Exit Sub
N = N + 1
Dim index As Long
index = N
Log = Log & "s" & CStr(index) & "(" & CStr(Range("B1").Value2) & ")>"
If index = 1 Then
Range("A1").Value2 = 7
End If
Log = Log & "<s" & CStr(index) & "(" & CStr(Range("B1").Value2) & ");"
End Sub
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.Calculation = -4135
Range("A1").Value2 = 1
Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*2"
Application.Calculate
Application.EnableEvents = True
Application.Calculate
Log = ""
N = 0
Calls = 0
Armed = True
Range("A1").Value2 = 5
Application.Calculate
Probe = Log & "|" & CStr(N) & ":" & CStr(Range("A1").Value2) & ":" & CStr(Range("B1").Value2)
Probe = Probe & ":" & CStr(Calls)
Log = ""
Application.Calculate
Probe = Probe & "||" & Log & "|" & CStr(N) & ":" & CStr(Range("A1").Value2) & ":" & CStr(Range("B1").Value2) & ":" & CStr(Calls)
Armed = False
Application.EnableEvents = False
End Function
